sloka: अचिरप्रोषितं रामं चिरविप्रोषितं यथा ।द्रष्टुकामो जन: सर्वो जगाम सहसाश्रमम् ॥ २.१०२.३८॥
transliteration: aciraproṣitaṁ rāmaṁ ciraviproṣitaṁ yathā ।draṣṭukāmo jana: sarvo jagāma sahasāśramam ॥ 2.102.38॥

translations.english: The whole multitude of people at once rushed towards the hermitage wishing to see Rama as if he had left long ago though he had gone on exile very recently.
